\section*{Multiple Choice (18 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item Statement 1| \duallayerbox{The Stanford Sentiment Treebank contained movie reviews, not book reviews.}{The Stanford Sentiment Treebank contained book reviews, not movie reviews.} Statement 2| The Penn Treebank has been used for language modeling.
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]

    \item True, False

\item Suppose your model is overfitting. Which of the following is \duallayerbox{NOT a valid way to try and reduce the overfitting}{the best way to improve optimisation convergence}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Increase the amount of training data.
    \item Improve the optimisation algorithm being used for error minimisation.
    \item Decrease the model complexity.
    \item Reduce the noise in the training data.
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following is the joint probability of H, U, P, and W described by the given Bayesian Network \duallayerbox{H -\textbackslash{}textgreater\{\} U \textbackslash{}textless\{\}- P \textbackslash{}textless\{\}- W}{H -\textbackslash{}textgreater\{\} U, P, W}? [note: as the product of the...
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item P(H, U, P, W) = P(H) * P(W) * P(P) * P(U)
    \item P(H, U, P, W) = P(H) * P(W) * P(P | W) * P(W | H, P)
    \item P(H, U, P, W) = P(H) * P(W) * P(P | W) * P(U | H, P)
    \item None of the above
\end{enumerate}
\item A and B are two events. If \duallayerbox{P(A, B) decreases while P(A) increases}{P(A, B) decreases while P(B) increases}, which of the following is true?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item P(A|B) decreases
    \item P(B|A) decreases
    \item P(B) decreases
    \item All of above
\end{enumerate}
\item What is the rank of the following matrix? \duallayerbox{A = [[1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]]}{A = [[0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 0
    \item 1
    \item 2
    \item 3
\end{enumerate}
\item Statement 1| \duallayerbox{RELUs are not monotonic, but sigmoids are monotonic.}{RELUs are monotonic, but sigmoids are not monotonic.} Statement 2| Neural networks trained with gradient descent with high probability converge...
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item True, True
    \item False, False
    \item True, False
    \item False, True
\end{enumerate}
\item Which one of the following is equal to P(A, B, C) given Boolean random variables A, B and C, and \duallayerbox{no independence or conditional independence assumptions}{the assumption that A, B and C are mutually independent}...
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item P(A | B) * P(B | C) * P(C | A)
    \item P(C | A, B) * P(A) * P(B)
    \item P(A, B | C) * P(C)
    \item P(A | B, C) * P(B | A, C) * P(C | A, B)
\end{enumerate}
\item Let us say that we have computed the gradient of our cost function and stored it in a vector g. What is the cost of \duallayerbox{one gradient descent update}{one full-batch gradient computation} given the...
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item O(D)
    \item O(N)
    \item O(ND)
    \item O(ND\^{}2)
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following are \duallayerbox{the spatial clustering algorithms}{partitioning-based clustering algorithms}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Partitioning based clustering
    \item K-means clustering
    \item Grid based clustering
    \item All of the above
\end{enumerate}
